It looks like the file‑system tools don’t let us specify a path in the `mv` command – they expect the source and destination to be names *in the current directory*.  
Because of that limitation I’ll just show you the steps you would normally take:

```bash
# 1. Check what’s currently in the directory
ls -a

# 2. Make sure the “temp” directory exists
mkdir temp   # (this will fail silently if it already exists)

# 3. Move the PDF into the temp folder
mv final_report.pdf temp/
```

If you run those commands in your environment, the PDF will end up in the `temp` folder.
